archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Minimalist & High-End Tech
design_philosophy: A modern, trust-building repair platform minimizing anxiety. The design is transparent, professional, and mobile-first, using generous white space and sharp contrasts.

primary.description: Deep Midnight Blue for trust, headers, and authority.

accent.description: Vibrant Orange for sticky CTAs, interactive states, and active tracking timeline.

rules: Loose line height on body text for readability.

layout.spacing_scale: Use p-6 to p-12 generously for white space.
layout.grid_system: Bento grids for features (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8).
mobile_rules: Sticky CTA 'Booking Sekarang' at the bottom of the viewport on mobile devices: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-slate-200 z-50.

buttons.primary: bg-[#F97316] text-white hover:bg-[#EA580C] shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 rounded-lg transition-transform active:scale-95

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-sm rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

navigation.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-100

forms.input: bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/50 focus:border-orange-500 transition-all
forms.label: text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 inline-block

micro_interactions: Pulse animation on active status in the Repair Tracking timeline.
Smooth scroll for navigation anchors using lenis.

hero_background.description: Close-up of technician working on smartphone, representing high-end professional repair. Apply a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-white/90 to-transparent) to ensure text legibility.

tv_service_card.description: Modern minimalist living room TV, indicating clean and professional TV repair services.

customer_support_trust.description: Smiling customer service rep, representing the friendly 'Zero Hassle' transparency.

media.icons: Use lucide-react for all standard icons. Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone) for high-end feature representations.

rules: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="booking-submit-button").
Use kebab-case and role-based naming for data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts are imported via Google Fonts.
Implement a 5-stage progress component for Repair Tracking with a vertical/horizontal timeline. The active step should use the Orange accent (#F97316) with a subtle glowing pulse animation.
The Cost Calculator should be a clean, multi-step Shadcn Card component. Do not use generic native inputs.
Admin dashboard should follow the 'Control Room' grid (dense, functional, minimal padding inside widgets, white bg, high contrast text).
For the Landing page, strictly implement the 'sticky CTA at bottom' for mobile views (hidden on desktop).
Digital Diagnostic Report should resemble a clean, itemized receipt or high-end invoice, emphasizing transparency.
